fusions.name: Dismasting Shot
fusions.desc: Throws two weights joined by links into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Let Go the Bower
fusions.desc: Drops your anchor at your feet, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Boom Across the Mouth
fusions.desc: Hauls a harbour boom of heavy links 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Paying Out Cable
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a link builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: the cable snaps taut and strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per link. Unfed, a link fades every 4 seconds.
